entries.061eddb46cf7088a: A group consisting of the company and 22 subsidiaries. A specialist manufacturer whose main business is the manufacture, processing and sale of various products made of engineering plastics and their composite materials; its head office is in Kawaguchi, Saitama Prefecture. Consolidated headcount is 1,371 employees (as of March 31, 2026). Research and development is carried out across all business fields by the company and Enplas Kenkyusho Co., Ltd.; ENPLAS AMERICA, INC. oversees the group's North American region, and ENPLAS（EUROPE）LTD. oversees the group companies in Europe.
entries.0e1601470c14954d: A business that manufactures and sells products for automotive equipment, OA, instruments and housing equipment, centered on high-precision gears. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,201 million. In Japan, QMS Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells them, and overseas, ENPLAS (U.S.A.), INC., ENPLAS PRECISION (MALAYSIA) SDN.BHD., ENPLAS PRECISION (THAILAND) CO.,LTD. and others manufacture and sell them.
entries.19cd3b931448ebdc: The company has formulated a medium-term management plan, setting “Creating customer value as a solution provider” as its medium-term management policy, and is working to expand its business areas and raise added value through a niche-top strategy. It states that it will concentrate management resources in growth areas and actively invest in human resources. Its priority measures include growing the Semiconductor Business and diversifying the business portfolio, creating customer value through its Innovation Center, growing each business and expanding business areas, and investing in growth fields while thoroughly recovering that investment.
entries.1b2182352857f64c: A business that manufactures and sells various IC test sockets and burn-in sockets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,603 million. In Japan, Enplas Handotai Kiki Co., Ltd. and QMS Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell the products; overseas, ENPLAS SEMICONDUCTOR PERIPHERALS PTE.LTD. and others manufacture and sell them, and ENPLAS TECH SOLUTIONS, INC. and others sell them.

entries.bee20292fd5bef36: Its strength lies in deploying, from its core technology of ultra-precision processing of engineering plastics cultivated since its founding, precision molding technology, fine contact technology, optical design and luminous flux control technology, and microfluidic channel technology to semiconductor IC sockets, opto devices, life science products and others, respectively. Including gear development built on the elemental technologies of high precision, high strength and quiet operation, it is distinctive in extending different technologies for each application from the same material and processing base.
entries.cebd25ca075ecd31: This is a business model in which the company, built on ultra-precision processing of engineering plastics at its core, manufactures IC test sockets, life science products, optical communication devices, precision gears and others, and sells them to customers in Japan and overseas to generate revenue.

Overseas, ENPLAS HI-TECH（SINGAPORE）PTE.LTD., ENPLAS TECH SOLUTIONS, INC. and others sell the products, and ENPLAS（VIETNAM）CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells them.
entries.d19a13445367e00e: The core of the strategy is to capture business opportunities arising from the social implementation of AI in each business. Read together with the revenue breakdown by business, the company states that while growing the Semiconductor Business, which accounts for a majority of revenue, it will accelerate investment to broaden its portfolio and avoid over-concentration. The approach of drawing out customers' challenges and ideas at the Innovation Center and providing prototyping, verification and evaluation as one integrated service also reflects an aim to create customer value beyond product sales.
